title: Circuit-to-three-CNF encoding adapter
statement: Given canonical binary encodings of Boolean circuits and three-CNF formulas, an adapter consists of a polynomial-time map on binary strings such that every encoded circuit is mapped to the encoding of its circuit-to-three-CNF conversion, and every string that fails to decode as a circuit is mapped to a string that fails to decode as a three-CNF formula.
hypotheses_covered: A canonical binary encoding of encoded Boolean circuits
A canonical binary encoding of encoded three-CNF formulas
A polynomial-time map on binary strings
Correct behavior on every canonical circuit encoding
Malformed circuit encodings map to malformed three-CNF encodings
